span.p:
External API (Stripe)
HTTP POST /charge
Payload: ~2 KB
RTT: 50-500ms

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
│ Resource Usage │
│ per API Call │
│ │
│ TCP connection │ 1 fd
│ TLS handshake │ 3 RTTs
│ Request body │ ~2 KB egress
│ Response body │ ~8 KB ingress
│ Total time │ 150-600ms
└─────────────────┘

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
│ At 500 concurrent API calls: │
│ File descriptors used: 500 (+200 DB + 100 cache = 800) │
│ Network bandwidth: 500 x 10KB = 5 MB/s (~40 Mbps) │
│ Open connections: 500 (TIME_WAIT + ESTABLISHED) │

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
More vCPU: Does NOT help (waiting on network RTT)
More RAM: Does NOT help (each connection ~50 KB)
Fix: Connection keep-alive + connection pooling
Or: async I/O (asyncio / eventlet) for non-blocking

div.style: display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 1000px; text-align: center;

span.div:
│ Bottleneck: Number of concurrent connections, not bandwidth │
│ Default ulimit -n: 1024 │
│ Required: 800+ (within default, but close) │
│ Fix: ulimit -n 65535 in systemd service file │
